newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends lower on technical sell.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends lower on technical sell.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices fell further at the close on persistent liquidation and technical selling after a volatile session. Selling increased particularly in the afternoon on lack of leads and mixed Chicago soyoil prices. Dec futures broke 1,145 support level, and next support seen at 1,130.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Lack of demand also eased the market, with business mainly on nearby crude palm oil and palm olein.
More technical selling emerged when third month December futures broke the support level of 1,145 ringgit a tonne, they said, adding that the next support will be at 1,130.

By the close, the contract fell 22 ringgit to 1,139 ringgit ($455.96) a tonne after trading between 1,134 and 1,162 ringgit. The increased selling saw turnover rising to 3,878 lots against 1,532 lots on Tuesday.

Lack of export demand also weakened prices, traders said, adding that there were no tenders today after India's STC on Tuesday bought 6,000 tonnes of RBD palm olein at $572.40 a tonne for October 5-20 shipment.
Physicals Sep (south) crude palm oil was quoted sellers at 1,170 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,180 to 1,170. Sep (central) saw offers at 1,155 with bids at 1,140.
Sep (north) saw bids at 1,135 with no offers quoted.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,170 ringgit with bids at 1,165 after dealing from 1,177.50 to 1,170.
Oct (central) saw offers at 1,155 and bids at 1,140 and Nov (north) at 1,175 with bids at 1,167.50 with trades done at 1,180 and 1,175.
In refined products, Oct RBD palmoil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $495.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $532.50 and Nov/Dec at $525. Oct was traded from $537.50 to $532.50 and Nov at $527.50.
Sep/Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $400 and Nov/Dec at $402.50. Sep/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $335.
